title: Rabbi Ze’ira bar Hillel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 3:5 and Maaserot, chapter 1, end of halakhah 4, where he said that it is a dispute between Rabbi Yonah and Rabbi Yose, according to the Ran’s reading on chapter 3 of Shabbat, siman 340. So it is in the Ritva, 41b, and in Yuchasin HaShalem; the reading Hyman uses is Rabbi Chanina bar Hillel.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:5 reads Chananya son of Rabbi Hillel. The notice gives Chanina and reports the Ran, Ritva and Yuchasin readings.
